bugs.error_message: A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match the client properties; iframe srcdoc stayed empty
bugs.root_cause: srcdoc computed from window.location.origin during render: server rendered '' and client rendered the real string, React refused to patch the mismatch
bugs.fix: Resolve origin in useEffect into state; render empty srcdoc on the server and first client pass

bugs.error_message: GET /_blob/<id> and /_files/... returned 404 from the Next not-found page
bugs.root_cause: App Router ignores folders starting with `_` (private folders)
bugs.fix: Moved to src/app/blob and src/app/files and added rewrites for /_blob and /_files in next.config.ts

bugs.error_message: ReferenceError: window is not defined at ShareDialog
bugs.root_cause: Client component read window.location during SSR render

bugs.error_message: TypeError: Invalid URL input '/api/v1/emails' from Better Auth magic-link on production
bugs.root_cause: Coolify passes every compose env var, so SENDSPRITE_URL arrived as an empty string; the sendsprite SDK reads that env itself and used '' as baseUrl
